rationale: The agent did look up the user by name and ZIP, which satisfies basic authentication. However, it performed an order-changing action (initiated an exchange) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing write. It also stated a specific refund amount ($10.48) to PayPal without any visible tool-result support, and for an upgrade from 30ml to 100ml a refund is implausible, suggesting incorrect or fabricated information. Additionally, the user asked to place a new order for the maximum size if possible and only exchange if a new order couldn’t be placed; the agent skipped attempting a new order or explaining why it couldn’t, and proceeded directly to exchange. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
